attchmntText: Alicon Castalloy Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Alicon Castalloy Limited has scheduled an in-person investor meeting on Friday, 20th November, 2026 at 9:00 a.m. The company intimated this event to the BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. The notice was issued by Sneha Shukla, Company Secretary, on 17th November, 2026.

attchmntText: Alicon Castalloy Limited has informed the Exchange about Link of Recording
voiceSummary: Alicon Castalloy Limited has submitted the audio recording of its analysts conference call held on November 16, 2026. The call followed the announcement of unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The audio file is available at the provided link and has also been uploaded to the company website. The company requests that this information be taken on record by the stock exchanges.

attchmntText: Alicon Castalloy Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 14, 2026, titled "Press Release ".
voiceSummary: Alicon Castalloy Limited announced financial results for the quarter ended 30th September 2026. Total income reached Rs. 652.0 crore, a 50% increase year-on-year and 13% quarter-on-quarter. Profit after tax was Rs. 17.6 crore, up 27% year-on-year and 54% quarter-on-quarter. EBITDA stood at Rs. 65.3 crore. For the half year ended 30th September 2026, total income was Rs. 1,231.0 crore. Profit after tax was Rs. 29.0 crore. Diluted earnings per share were Rs. 17.78. The company reported its highest-ever quarterly sales. Production at the new Pune facility is targeted to commence by April 2027.

attchmntText: Alicon Castalloy Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Alicon Castalloy Limited filed a presentation regarding its Q2 and H1 FY27 results for the quarter ended 30th September, 2026. In Q2 FY27, total income reached Rs. 652 crore, with EBITDA at Rs. 65.3 crore and PAT at Rs. 17.6 crore. For H1 FY27, total income was Rs. 1,231 crore, EBITDA stood at Rs. 120.6 crore, and PAT was Rs. 29.05 crore. The company reported new business wins and improved capacity utilization of around 86%. A conference call is scheduled for 11:30 am IST on Monday, November 16, 2026.
